description: This file defines a mock class 'SharedMemoryBufferMock' for the 'ISharedMemoryBuffer' interface, used for unit testing in the Rialto server component. It includes mock method declarations for buffer management operations related to media playback, such as mapping/unmapping partitions, clearing data, and retrieving buffer information.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the ISharedMemoryBuffer interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: mapPartition
methods.description: Mocks the mapping of a media playback partition.

methods.name: unmapPartition
methods.description: Mocks the unmapping of a media playback partition.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Mocks clearing data in a media playback partition.

methods.name: getDataOffset
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the data offset within the buffer.

methods.name: getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the maximum data length.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a pointer to the data buffer.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the file descriptor associated with the buffer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the size of the buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a pointer to the buffer.
